senses.def: A specialist operations section of the Metropolitan Police Service responsible for counter-terrorism
A Mon-Khmer-speaking people of Laos and Thailand.
A Chinese surname from Cantonese.
the syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
to a very great extent or degree
ex: the idea is so obvious
never been so happy

senses.def: in a manner that facilitates
ex: he observed the snakes so he could describe their behavior
he stooped down so he could pick up his hat

senses.def: in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied
ex: They're happy and I hope they will remain so
so live your life that old age will bring no regrets

senses.def: to a certain unspecified extent or degree
ex: I can only go so far with this student
can do only so much in a day

senses.def: in the same way; also
ex: I was offended and so was he
worked hard and so did she

senses.def: in the way indicated
ex: hold the brush so
set up the pieces thus

senses.def: (usually followed by ‘that’) to an extent or degree as expressed
ex: he was so tired he could hardly stand
so dirty that it smells

senses.def: subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors)
ex: then he left
go left first, then right

senses.def: (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
ex: therefore X must be true
the eggs were fresh and hence satisfactory

senses.def: in truth (often tends to intensify)
ex: they said the car would break down and indeed it did
it is very cold indeed

senses.def: As a result; for that reason; therefore; because of this; due to this.
ex: I was hungry, so I asked if there was any more food.
He ate too much cake and so he fell ill.

senses.def: Used to connect previous conversation or events to the following question.
ex: So how does this story end?

senses.def: Used to introduce a rhetorical question.
ex: “We'd like to visit but I don't know if we can afford a hotel.” — “So who's staying in a hotel? Stay with us.”

senses.def: To the (explicitly stated) extent.
ex: It was so hot outside that all the plants died.
He was so good, they hired him on the spot.

senses.def: To the (implied) extent.
ex: I need a piece of cloth so long. [= this long]

senses.def: Very (positive or negative clause).
ex: I feel so much better now.
I so nearly lost my temper.

senses.def: Very much.
ex: But I so want to see the Queen when she visits our town!

senses.def: at all (negative clause).
ex: That is so not true!

senses.def: In the same manner or to the same extent as aforementioned; likewise, also.
ex: As above, so below.

Just as you have the right to your free speech, so I have the right to mine.  Many people say she's the world's greatest athlete, but I don't think so.  "I can count backwards from one hundred." "So can I."

senses.def: Indeed.
ex: ‘Look, it’s just stopped raining.’ ‘So it has!’
‘There are two more.’ ‘So there are.’

senses.def: To such an extent or degree; as.
ex: so far as;  so long as;  so much as

senses.def: Agreeing with actual facts or reality; true.
ex: That is so.
You are responsible for this, is that not so?

senses.def: In that state or manner; with that attribute. A proadjective that replaces the aforementioned adjective phrase.
ex: "You're definitely not right about that." "I am so!" (→I am right about that).

senses.def: Homosexual.
ex: Is he so?

senses.def: Used after a pause for thought to introduce a new topic, question or story, or a new thought or question in continuation of an existing topic.
ex: So, let's go home.
So, what'll you have?

senses.def: Used as a question to ask for further explanation of something said, often rhetorically or in a dismissive or impolite manner.
ex: "You park your car in front of my house every morning." — "So?"

senses.def: Used as a meaningless filler word to begin a response to a question.
ex: What are you doing? / So I'm just fixing this shelf.
What time does the train leave? / So it leaves at 10 o'clock.

senses.def: That which was previously mentioned; that.
ex: I'll become a loyal friend and remain so.
If that's what you really mean, then just say so.

senses.def: A syllable used in solfège to represent the fifth note of a major scale.
Sometimes syllable for both the second and the fifth.
A type of dairy product, made especially in Japan between the seventh and tenth centuries, by reducing milk by boiling it.
